title: A Thousand Stars and You
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
One night a man looked up and saw
a thousand stars up high;
His heart was full of wonder, so
he sang up to the sky.

[Chorus]
God made the sky so full of stars,
and still He knows you, too;
You're precious to Him, little one,
His heart has room for you.

[Verse 2]
"You made the moon, You made the stars,
and put them in their place;
And yet You see each child of Yours,
You know each little face."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; the stars will shine
above you while you sleep;
The God who hung them in the sky
is near; His love is deep.

[Chorus]
mood: Twinkling music. A light, slow rock moves under the voice, with small bright touches blinking on one by one like stars coming out at dusk. The first two verses keep that gentle sparkle as the singer looks up in wonder. By the last verse it grows lower and slower, the twinkles spaced far apart, the wide sky watching over one small, sleepy child.
